pageTitle: UCLA Summer Camp for International students | MLI- Annex
pageDescription: Join the premier summer camp at UCLA for International students, MLI-Annex. Experience immersive English language programs, cultural activities, and campus life in Los Angeles. Enroll now for an unforgettable summer adventure!
note: Please fill out the form in English.
name: Name

extraAccomodationNights: Extra Day In Residence: $375 per day
minorServiceNote: *If you are using the Unaccompanied Minor Service and are adding either an Irregular Pick-up or Drop-off, only the $160 fee will apply; however, if you request both Pick-up and Drop-off, the total fee will be $320.
specialPickupNote: Flight Arrival between 17:31-20:30 (outside of the regular shuttle schedule) ($160). Pick-up is guaranteed for flights arriving by 20:30.
specialDropoffNote: Flight Departure between 15:00-17:00 (outside of the regular shuttle schedule) ($160). Please arrange a flight schedule to depart LAX no later than 17:00.
leaveCourseTxt: It is possible to leave the course at any time during the term. When departing from the course, in order to display the intention of the students themselves, it is necessary to submit a written statement stating that. In addition, schools may offer to withdraw from the course, such as when inappropriate behavior, attendance rate and grades do not satisfy standards as students.
rightToTerminationTxt: You have the right to cancel this enrollment and obtain a refund of charges paid for attendance more than 45 days prior to the scheduled arrival date. 'Cancellation' is defined as any voluntary change in enrollment or request for a refund before the actual enrollment.
refundPolicyTxt1: If the student wishes to cancel, he or she must notify the MLI- Annex in more than 45 days prior to the scheduled move in date.
refundPolicyTxt2: If the cancellation deadline has passed, no refund will be issued.
signatureSelectionTxt: I have read and understood all of the above and I agree to all these terms and conditions.
